remarks: Timeless Georgian architecture meets exceptional craftsmanship in this gracious brick residence, beautifully positioned on a quiet and convenient cul-de-sac. Comprehensively reimagined in 2006, the home showcases enduring materials and classic architectural detailing, including brick quoins, stone window sills, soldier-course brick with keystones, and dentil molding. Rare, flat, park-like acreage with mature landscaping and broad frontage enhance the home's impressive approach. A dramatic two-story foyer with a sweeping staircase and intricate millwork introduces the home's refined interior architecture. Formal and everyday rooms flow effortlessly, enhanced by high ceilings, custom paneling, and a refined overall scale that reinforces the home's sophistication. A private main-level office with a marble fireplace offers an ideal workspace. The chef's kitchen features Sub-Zero and Viking appliances, granite countertops, an expansive center island, and a generous eat-in area that opens into the home's main living spaces. French doors and sliders extend the interior to the terrace and broad, level backyard, creating seamless indoor/outdoor living. The upper level offers excellent scale, beginning with a bright landing that includes an inviting sitting area. The gracious primary suite features a fireplace, walk-in closet, and a generously sized bath with excellent proportions.
